_comment: Two different maps. Don't conflate them.
lookup: roster slug -> the scientific name to QUERY Wikidata/Wikipedia under.
Build-time only. Use when the name the art is filed under doesn't resolve.
slug: scientific name BirdNET-Go REPORTS -> the roster slug it should register.
Ships to the browser inside birdex.json. Without an entry here, a species
whose taxonomy moved stays permanently dark in the Birdex even though the
_merge_comment: duplicate slug -> canonical slug, for when the illustration set files ONE
species under two genus names. The duplicate is dropped from the roster
(no phantom number, no permanently-dark twin) and folded into the runtime
slug map, so BirdNET-Go reporting either name registers the same entry.
Canonical is the modern name, since that's what the model reports.
The build fails if two entries share an Avibase ID or eBird code without
a merge here - that's how these three were caught.
